_about: Camps that are made of several camps (world/camp.gd). A Camp node whose id is a key here holds one camp for each room: `rooms` lists them, each with its own camp id, the plan room it stands in (data/plans/<zone>.json `rooms`) and the node names of its creatures. A room's camp follows the camp rules on its own: when its last creature is freed it sets camp_cleared:<its id> and reports camp:<its id>, and it stays empty from then on. The whole camp is cleared when every room is. Glint is paid under the whole camp's id (`<camp>/<name>`), so nothing here changes who has paid.

undercroft_rooms.why: its five creatures stand in three rooms. As one camp, going down in the seal room brought back the stair hall and the root corridor (the mechanics review, 14 Nov)
